why.title: Built so the drop can't go down.
why.lede: Most stores run on a server. A sellout crowd is exactly what knocks a server over. We don't have one to knock over.

rows.them: One origin server. The crowd hits it at once: queue pages, timeouts, 503s.
rows.us: No origin server. The site is static files on Cloudflare's edge in 300+ cities, and the live room is split across thousands of small edge workers. Built for millions of fans at once.

rows.them: Inventory checked in a busy database. Oversells, then apology emails.
rows.us: One atomic counter per drop. Zero oversell, tested against a stampede of hundreds of buyers on 100 units.

rows.them: Refresh and hope it's still in stock.
rows.us: Every sale lands for everyone as a hitmarker, in milliseconds. The countdown, the reveal and the sellout are the show.
Human check before the first buy, holds that expire, a per-person limit counted at payment.
One second, every timezone. Mystery drops reveal for the whole crowd on the same tick.

rows.them: Servers you pay for all month, idle 99% of it.
rows.us: Serverless: you pay for the minutes the drop is live. A quiet shop costs nothing to keep up.
